intent: Pareto chart of defect types by frequency

top_recommendation.description: Bar chart sorted descending with cumulative % line (80/20 rule).
top_recommendation.clinical_use: Top AEs by frequency with cumulative %
top_recommendation.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='Pareto chart of <numeric> by <factor>'

alternatives.description: Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.
alternatives.clinical_use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

alternatives.description: Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.
alternatives.clinical_use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
alternatives.note: n_samples=10 is small — Dotplot shows every observation clearly.

alternatives.description: Stacked density plots per group — compare distributions without overlap.

alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='ridgeline plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

alternatives.description: Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.
alternatives.clinical_use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

html.content:
Recommended

Paretoscore: 1.0

Bar chart sorted descending with cumulative % line (80/20 rule).

Clinical use: Top AEs by frequency with cumulative %

  • cat + numeric → ranked bar + cumulative %

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='Pareto chart of <numeric> by <factor>'

It is ideal for defect analysis

Alternatives

Barscore: 1.0

Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.

Clinical use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group

  • 1+ category + 1+ numeric
  • exactly 1 cat, 1 num — classic bar
  • small-medium dataset
  • manageable category count

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

Dotplotscore: 0.85

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • cat + numeric
  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Ridgelinescore: 0.85

Stacked density plots per group — compare distributions without overlap.

Clinical use: Lab distributions across multiple visits or arms

  • cat + numeric → stacked densities
  • several groups to compare
  • 4+ groups → ridgeline avoids overlapping color curves

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='ridgeline plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Boxplotscore: 0.8

Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.

Clinical use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints

  • cat + numeric → distribution by group

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'
